# `map_contains_key`

<!-- @generated by `cargo xtask docs-sql`; do not edit. -->

```text
map_contains_key(map, key)
```

Returns true if the map contains the key.

| | |
|---|---|
| Krishiv | Implemented |
| Group | `map_funcs` |
| Kind | scalar (function) |
| Added in Spark | 3.3.0 |
| In Spark profiles | 3.5 and later |
| Arguments | 2 |
| Deterministic | yes |

## Examples

```sql
SELECT map_contains_key(map(1, 'a', 2, 'b'), 1);
```

Result:

```text
true
```

```sql
SELECT map_contains_key(map(1, 'a', 2, 'b'), 3);
```

Result:

```text
false
```
